title: reviewDeployment
responsibility: Builds a short-lived deployment plan with target identity, immutable source, predecessor proof and blockers.

inputs.name: reviewDeployment.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: reviewDeployment.input
inputs.description: Requested environment and immutable source commit with the originating project identity.

inputs.name: reviewDeployment.options
inputs.type: { plugin: DeploymentPlugin; projectId: string | null; queuedChange?: boolean }
inputs.description: Adapter and project identity, with an explicit flag for lower-environment chat-chain admission.

outputs.name: reviewDeployment
outputs.description: Reviewed immutable plan with expiry, target, predecessor receipt and configuration fingerprint.
